sloka: इमं च तीव्रं मम शोकवेगं रक्षोभिरेभिः परिभर्त्सनं च ।ब्रूयास्तु रामस्य गतः समीपं शिवश्च ते ऽध्वा ऽस्तु हरिप्रवीर ।। ५.४०.२४।।।।
transliteration: imaṁ ca tīvraṁ mama śokavegaṁ rakṣobhirebhiḥ paribhartsanaṁ ca ।brūyāstu rāmasya gataḥ samīpaṁ śivaśca te 'dhvā 'stu haripravīra ।। 5.40.24।।।।

translations.english: "Foremost vanara tell Rama about my intense grief as well as the threats of the demons. May your journey be happy.
